newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 8.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Friday:
* More than one billion extra shares of microchip giant Taiwan Semiconductor, issued during earlier ex-bonus issue, begin trading in market.
* George Hou, analyst, Jardine Fleming: "A piece of news like this is hard to characterise as either bullish or bearish. It all depends on market sentiment."
* Brokers say market also watching whether constructions can continue recent bargain-hunting strength.
* Market up more than 40 percent in 1997, but momentum slipping in past week on profit-taking.
* Foreign funds, securities investment trust funds posted net selling of combined T$4.1 billion on Thursday.
* Index ended 0.21 percent/20.59 points down at 9,840.88 on Thursday.
